profile.summary: Coastal Corporation Limited engages in the process, production, and distribution of sea food products in India. It offers sea caught and aquaculture shrimps, including sea tiger, whites, pink brown, vannamei, and black tiger shrimps. The company also provides shrimp products such as, raw, cooked, individually quick frozen, peeled, deveined, butterfly, breaded, skewered, and other value-added ready
